title: El primer sábado de Alex
reading: Alex is new in town. On Saturday, he meets Mia at the library. The library opens at nine, but they meet at ten. Alex wants a book about animals. Mia wants a book for her little brother. After the library, they walk to a small café next to the park. Alex has tea and a sandwich. Mia has water because she does not like tea. The café is quiet in the morning. At twelve, Mia goes home. Alex stays in the park and reads his new book.
translation: Alex es nuevo en la ciudad. El sábado se reúne con Mia en la biblioteca. La biblioteca abre a las nueve, pero ellos quedan a las diez. Alex quiere un libro sobre animales. Mia quiere uno para su hermano pequeño. Después caminan a un café junto al parque. Alex toma té y un sándwich. Mia toma agua porque no le gusta el té. El café es tranquilo por la mañana. A las doce Mia vuelve a casa. Alex se queda en el parque y lee su nuevo libro.

title: La maleta que llegó después
reading: When Ella arrived in Bristol on Friday, her suitcase was missing. She went to the airline desk and filled in a form. The assistant said the suitcase was still in Paris and would arrive the next morning. Ella was staying with her cousin, Oliver, for the weekend. She only had her phone, a book and a light jacket in her small bag. Oliver lent her a clean shirt and took her to a shop for a toothbrush. On Saturday morning, the airline called. They offered to send the suitcase to Oliver's flat between two and four. Ella and Oliver had planned to visit a museum, but they changed their plans. They visited a nearby market in the morning and went to the museum on Sunday. The suitcase arrived at half past three, with everything inside.
translation: Ella llegó a Bristol el viernes, pero faltaba su maleta. Rellenó un formulario en el mostrador. Le dijeron que la maleta seguía en París y llegaría al día siguiente. Se quedaba el fin de semana con su primo Oliver. En el bolso tenía el móvil, un libro y una chaqueta. Oliver le prestó una camisa y la llevó a comprar un cepillo. El sábado la aerolínea ofreció llevar la maleta al piso entre las dos y las cuatro. Cambiaron su plan de ir al museo: fueron al mercado por la mañana y al museo el domingo. La maleta llegó a las tres y media con todo dentro.

listening.text: Hello, this is the airline delivery team. We are calling about Ella's suitcase. Our driver is running late and will arrive at about five, not before four as we said earlier. If nobody can be at the flat, we can leave the suitcase with the building manager. Please call us before three to tell us what you prefer.

Si no puede haber nadie en el piso, podemos dejarla con el encargado. Llámenos antes de las tres para decirnos qué prefiere.

title: Una manera de colaborar
reading: Mia joined a volunteer group that repaired old computers for local families. The group met every Thursday evening. Although members were friendly, new volunteers often left after a few weeks. Mia noticed that experienced members used technical terms without explaining them. Beginners spent much of the evening watching because they were afraid of damaging something. She suggested pairing each beginner with an experienced volunteer for the first three sessions. Some members worried that this would slow down repairs. The coordinator agreed to try the idea for a month rather than change the whole system immediately. Mia prepared a short checklist with pictures, but she deliberately left space for questions instead of writing a long manual. At the end of the month, the group had repaired slightly fewer computers, yet more beginners were able to complete simple tasks on their own. The coordinator decided to keep the pairs and review repair numbers after three months. Mia learned that a useful change can have a short-term cost, and that explaining the purpose of a change helps other people support it.
translation: Mia entró en un grupo que reparaba ordenadores para familias. Muchos principiantes se iban pronto. Observó términos técnicos sin explicar y miedo a estropear algo. Propuso acompañar a cada nuevo voluntario durante tres sesiones. Algunos temían ralentizar las reparaciones. La coordinadora aceptó probarlo un mes. Mia preparó una lista breve con imágenes y espacio para preguntas. Repararon algo menos, pero más principiantes pudieron hacer tareas solos. Mantuvieron las parejas y acordaron revisar las cifras a los tres meses. Mia aprendió que una mejora puede tener un coste inicial y que explicar su propósito facilita el apoyo.

listening.text: Hi Mia, I've read the feedback. The beginners liked working in pairs, but two said they never knew what to practise next. Could you add a small section to the checklist where partners agree on one goal for the following week? Please keep the existing pictures. We can discuss your draft on Thursday; there is no need to print copies yet.
listening.translation: Hola Mia, he leído los comentarios. A los principiantes les gustó trabajar en parejas, pero dos no sabían qué practicar después. Añade una sección para acordar un objetivo de la semana siguiente. Conserva las imágenes. Veremos el borrador el jueves; aún no hace falta imprimir.

title: Lo que una encuesta no demuestra
reading: A transport company surveyed passengers after introducing a quieter carriage on one of its commuter routes. Of the people who responded, 82 per cent said their journeys had improved. The company described this as strong evidence that quiet carriages should be introduced across the network. However, the survey link had been displayed mainly inside the new carriage, and responses were voluntary. Passengers who avoided the carriage were unlikely to see it. A local researcher welcomed the company's willingness to collect feedback but questioned whether the sample represented all passengers. She also pointed out that the trial had taken place during school holidays, when trains were less crowded. This did not mean the reported improvements were imaginary; it meant that the size and cause of the improvement remained uncertain. The company initially defended its conclusion, arguing that customers' experiences mattered more than technical criticism. After a public discussion, it agreed to run a second trial on three routes during term time. This time, staff would invite a selection of passengers from different carriages to respond, while recording crowding levels. The researcher supported the revised approach, although she warned that the results would still need careful interpretation. The disagreement shifted from whether quiet carriages were a good idea to what evidence would justify expanding them.
translation: Una empresa encuestó a pasajeros tras introducir un vagón silencioso. El 82 % de quienes respondieron notó una mejora. La empresa lo tomó como evidencia para extenderlo, pero el enlace estaba sobre todo dentro de ese vagón y responder era voluntario. Otros pasajeros probablemente no lo vieron. Una investigadora valoró recoger opiniones, pero cuestionó la representatividad y recordó que la prueba se hizo en vacaciones, con menos aglomeración. No negaba las mejoras: señalaba incertidumbre sobre su tamaño y causa. Tras una discusión, acordaron otra prueba en tres rutas durante el periodo lectivo, con pasajeros de varios vagones y datos de ocupación. La investigadora apoyó el diseño con cautela. La discusión pasó de la conveniencia de la idea a la evidencia necesaria para ampliarla.

listening.text: We are not postponing the second trial, but we are changing how we invite participants. Staff should approach every fifth passenger entering each selected carriage, rather than choosing people who seem willing to talk. If someone declines, record that and move on; do not replace them with a friend travelling beside them. This will not remove every source of bias, but it should make the selection more consistent.
listening.translation: No aplazamos la prueba; cambiamos cómo invitamos a participar. El personal debe acercarse a cada quinto pasajero que entre en cada vagón seleccionado, sin elegir a quienes parezcan dispuestos. Si alguien rechaza, anótenlo y continúen, sin sustituirlo por un amigo. No eliminará todos los sesgos, pero hará más consistente la selección.
